menu_order.instructions: Which of these menu actions is the user most likely to want next, given what they just did in `recent_actions`?

criteria.new_report: New report — Start a blank report from scratch
criteria.open_recent: Open recent — Reopen a report from the last few days
criteria.export_csv: Export CSV — Download the current view as a spreadsheet
criteria.schedule: Schedule delivery — Email this report on a recurring basis
criteria.share: Share with team — Grant teammates access to this report
criteria.retry_import: Retry import — Run the last failed data import again
criteria.view_errors: View import errors — Inspect rows that failed to load
criteria.settings: Workspace settings — Change billing, members, and defaults
